h04.

no; evidence: the code graph reports exactly one direct caller of `mysql.NewDB`: the driver-selection factory `db.NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go:14`. Its MySQL branch constructs the driver via `mysql.NewDB(profile)` at `store/db/db.go:21-22`. No other production caller was found. The only separate `DB` construction is a unit-test literal (`&DB{}`) within the MySQL package itself at `store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go:12`, not a direct construction of the MySQL driver outside the factory.
